family.description: This family contains a SAM (S-adenosyl methyltransferase) domain, with a central beta sheet with 3 alpha-helices on both sides. Crystal packing analysis of the structure PDB:3giw from [swissprot:Q82L35] suggests that a monomer is the solution state oligomeric form. An unidentified ligand (UNL, cyan) was found at the putative active site surrounded by the residues His57, His170, Phe171, Tyr216 and Met22 . The UNL is likely to be a phenylalanine or phenylalanine-like molecule. (details derived from TOPSAN).
family.name: S-adenosyl methyltransferase
